proofMethod: Default fresh IDE corpus, opt-in actual retained sessions, lifecycle tests and native hands-on run are distinct accepted executions. Proof JSON records each real session identity and cursor/source ownership. No fake backend trace is used. Details and history use actual retained terminal recordings, not a newly replayed JVM. History clip includes inspected cursors, camera choreography and then playback/manual orbit, not uninterrupted execution playback.

additionalFullSuiteCaptures.policy: Ignored full-suite PNG duplicates and incidental videos stay outside this commit. Canonical selected captures are retained under media; full-suite JSON/logs preserve checks.

limits: Bounded local path routing cannot prevent every projected crossing during arbitrary orbit or transient motion.
Macro labels/cells/collection previews are deliberately bounded; exact supported state requires Focus/Inspector/expand.
Banking video has gray padding during recorded viewport changes in a fixed video canvas; preserved without alteration.
Some retained-session screenshots show JDT starting/displaced; actual explicit Retry recovery is verified independently; bridge remains single-project.
GPU query commands, CPU render submission and JS heap are distinct domains, not physical frame latency, FPS, VRAM or cross-GPU certification.
Three-minute soak and five Runs do not prove universal leak freedom.
Observer limits and unsupported/native/library boundaries remain explicit; canonical Java I/O continues beyond partial visualization.
Materials/lighting remain simpler than cinematic references; no Phase 6 effects included.
